name: FamilyNestedText
grammar: grammar FamilyNestedText { @package: commonprobe @root  @mapping(Node) @commonField(value) Root ::= A | B; @nestedCaptures @mapping(A,params=[value]) A ::= 'a' [ {'x'} ] @value; @nestedCaptures @mapping(B,params=[value]) B ::= 'b' [ {'x'} ] @value;  }

name: FamilyNestedNode
grammar: grammar FamilyNestedNode { @package: commonprobe @root @nestedCaptures @mapping(Node) @commonField(value) Root ::= A | B; @nestedCaptures @mapping(Node.A,params=[value]) A ::= 'a' [ {Leaf} ] @value; @nestedCaptures @mapping(Node.B,params=[value]) B ::= 'b' [ {Leaf} ] @value; @mapping(Leaf,params=[text]) Leaf ::= '😀' @text; }

name: FamilyNestedEnum
grammar: grammar FamilyNestedEnum { @package: commonprobe @root  @mapping(Node) @commonField(value) Root ::= A | B; @nestedCaptures @mapping(Node.A,params=[value]) A ::= 'a' '[' { [Mode] } @value ']'; @nestedCaptures @mapping(Node.B,params=[value]) B ::= 'b' '[' { [Mode] } @value ']'; @enum Mode ::= 'on' | '😀'; }
